```{r}

library(lme4)

tt <- lmer(
  kg_ha ~ SB +
    (1 + SB | gen) +
    (1|trial/blk), data = data222)



re <- ranef(tt)$gen

damage_coef <- data.frame(
  gen = rownames(re),
  intercept = fixef(tt)[1] + re[, "(Intercept)"],
  damage_coef = fixef(tt)["SB"] + re[, "SB"]
)



fix <- fixef(tt)
re  <- ranef(tt)$gen

dc_gen <- data.frame(
  gen = rownames(re),
  B0  = fix["(Intercept)"] + re[, "(Intercept)"],
  B1  = fix["SB"]          + re[, "SB"]
)

dc_gen$DC <- (dc_gen$B1 / dc_gen$B0)*100


```

```{r}

ma_c_reg = regression
ma_c_reg = ma_c_reg |> 
filter(term %in% c("(Intercept)",".$SB"))
 
ma_c_reg[ma_c_reg$term== "(Intercept)",c("parameters")] <- "Intercept"
ma_c_reg[ma_c_reg$term== ".$SB",c("parameters")] <- "Slope"


b1_c = ma_c_reg |> 
  dplyr::filter(parameters == "Slope") |> 
  #filter(estimate < 0) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(gen) |> 
  summarise(
    Slope = estimate
  )

b0_c = ma_c_reg |> 
  filter(parameters == "Intercept") |>
  group_by(gen) |> 
  summarise(
    Intercept = estimate
  )

parameters_c = cbind(b1_c,b0_c)
parameters_c[,3] = NULL

parameters_c = parameters_c %>% 
  filter(Slope >=0)

dc_c = parameters_c %>% 
  group_by(gen) %>% 
  summarise(
    DC = (Slope/Intercept)*-1,
    b1= Intercept/1000,
    DC = DC*b1,
    DC_perc = DC*100
  )
```

# Economic losses

## Group 1

```{r}


set.seed(123)
sev = seq(0, 8,length.out = 100)
yld = seq(4000, 16000,length.out = 100)
b1 <- runif(100,min = 159.97, max = 430.21)
price_rice <- seq(300, 600,length.out = 10)

combined_data_g1 <- expand.grid(sev = sev, yld = yld, b1 = b1,price_rice = price_rice)


ylmer_simu_g1 = combined_data_g1 %>% 
  mutate(loss =((((((b1/11142.94)*sev)*100)*yld)/100)/1000)*price_rice)

ylmer_simu_g1$group = "Group 1"
ylmer_simu_g1$b0 = 11142.94


gc()
```

```{r}

ylmer_simu_min2 = ylmer_simu_all %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  mutate(loss =((((((b1/b0)*sev)*100)*yld)/100)/1000)) %>%
  group_by(group) %>% 
   mutate(pressure = case_when(sev > median(sev) ~ "High pressure",
                           sev <= median(sev) ~"Low pressure"),
          attainable = case_when(yld > median(yld) ~ "High yield",
                                 yld <= median(yld) ~"Low yield"))
         

```


```{r}
ylmer_simu_min2 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(pressure,loss))+
  geom_boxplot(na.rm = F)
```

```{r}
simu_summary <- ylmer_simu_min2 %>%
  group_by(group,pressure,attainable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_loss = mean(loss, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_low = quantile(loss, 0.025),
    ci_high = quantile(loss, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
pressure_cols <- c(
  "High pressure"  = "#6F3F1F",
  "Low pressure" = "#2E8B57")

```


```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)   

dodge_w <- 0.45   # mantenha o mesmo valor usado nas outras camadas

interval2 <- ylmer_simu_min2 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = pressure, y = loss)) +
  
  # Intervalos (médias + IC) lado a lado por attainable
  geom_pointrange(
    data = simu_summary,
    aes(
      x        = pressure,
      y        = mean_loss,
      ymin     = ci_low,
      ymax     = ci_high,
      color    = pressure,
      linetype = attainable,
      group    = attainable
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    size = 1.0
  ) +
  
  # Ponto da média (opcional)
  geom_point(
    data = simu_summary,
    aes(
      x     = pressure, 
      y     = mean_loss,
      color = pressure,
      shape = attainable,
      group = attainable
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  
  # Texto da média alinhado ao seu respectivo intervalo (lado a lado)
  geom_text(
    data = simu_summary,
    aes(
      x     = pressure,
      y     = ci_high,  # posiciona o rótulo próximo à ponta superior do IC
      # Opção 1 (base R):
      label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_loss),
      # Opção 2 (scales): label = number(mean_loss, accuracy = 0.01),
      color = pressure,
      group = attainable
    ),
    position   = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    nudge_x    = 0.08,    # -> direita (ajuste fino conforme seu espaçamento)
    nudge_y    = 0.08,       # pequeno empurrão para não colar na barra
    hjust      = -0.4,          # à direita; ajuste conforme preferir
    vjust      = 1,       # ligeiramente acima da ponta do intervalo
    size       = 5,
    fontface   = "bold.italic"
    #, check_overlap = TRUE   # opcional para evitar sobreposição
  ) +
  
  # Escalas
  scale_color_manual(values = pressure_cols, name = "Pressure") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Low yield" = "solid", "High yield" = "dashed"),
                        name = "Attainable") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Low yield" = 16, "High yield" = 17),
                     name = "Attainable") +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 1)+
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Pressure level",
    y = "Yield loss (ton/ha)"
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14,face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
  
  
interval2

```

# Economic damage threshold

## Group 1


```{r}
# Function to Simulate EDC
set.seed(123)

simula_LDE <- function(n, media_rp, sd_rp, eficacia, cd_base, custo_range, preco_range) {
  simulacoes <- tibble(
    rendimento_potencial = rnorm(n, media_rp, sd_rp),
    custo_controle = runif(n, custo_range[1], custo_range[2]),
    preco_produto = runif(n, preco_range[1], preco_range[2]),
    eficacia = eficacia
  ) %>% 
    mutate(
      cd_base = cd_base,
      coeficiente_dano = cd_base * rendimento_potencial,
      LDE = (custo_controle / (preco_produto * coeficiente_dano)) * eficacia
    )
  return(simulacoes)
}


n = 50000 # number of simulations
media_rp = 11.14 # in ton/ha
sd_rp = 0.70  # SD of attainable yield
eficacia = rnorm(50000, 0.54, 0.1) #  in proportion
cd_base = 0.02
custo_range = c(40, 160) # cust of control (US$)
preco_range = c(100, 600) # soybean price (US$)

# run the simulation
simula_g1 <- simula_LDE(n, media_rp, sd_rp, eficacia, cd_base, custo_range, preco_range)
```

```{r}
edt_g1 = simula_g1 |> 
  ggplot(aes(rendimento_potencial, eficacia, 
             color = LDE, size = coeficiente_dano))+
  geom_point()+
  #scale_color_viridis_c(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1))+
    scale_colour_stepsn(
    colours = c("#2E8B57",   # dark brown
                "#7FBF7B",   # medium brown
                "#D1BE91",   # beige transition
                "#A6764D",   # light green
                "#6F3F1F"),  # dark green
    n.breaks = 6,             # number of steps (adjust for contrast)
    breaks = seq(0, 8, 1),
    name = "EDT",
    guide = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = 6)   
  )
) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
   labs(color = "EDT",
     x = "Attainable yield (ton/ha)",
       y = "Fungicide efficacy (%)",
     size = "DC")+
  theme_bw()+
    theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 20, b = 0, l = 0),  # Aumenta a margem à direita da legenda
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18,face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
  )

edt_g1
```

```{r}
# Function to Simulate EDC
set.seed(123)

simula_LDE <- function(n, media_rp, sd_rp, eficacia, cd_base, custo_range, preco_range) {
  simulacoes <- tibble(
    rendimento_potencial = rnorm(n, media_rp, sd_rp),
    custo_controle = runif(n, custo_range[1], custo_range[2]),
    preco_produto = runif(n, preco_range[1], preco_range[2]),
    eficacia = eficacia
  ) %>% 
    mutate(
      cd_base = cd_base,
      coeficiente_dano = cd_base * rendimento_potencial,
      LDE = (custo_controle / (preco_produto * coeficiente_dano)) * eficacia
    )
  return(simulacoes)
}


n = 50000 # number of simulations
media_rp = 9.9 # in ton/ha
sd_rp = 0.70  # SD of attainable yield
eficacia = rnorm(50000, 0.54, 0.1) #  in proportion
cd_base = 0.02
custo_range = c(40, 160) # cust of control (US$)
preco_range = c(100, 600) # soybean price (US$)

# run the simulation
simula_g2 <- simula_LDE(n, media_rp, sd_rp, eficacia, cd_base, custo_range, preco_range)
```

## Group 3

```{r}
# Function to Simulate EDC
set.seed(123)

simula_LDE <- function(n, media_rp, sd_rp, eficacia, cd_base, custo_range, preco_range) {
  simulacoes <- tibble(
    rendimento_potencial = rnorm(n, media_rp, sd_rp),
    custo_controle = runif(n, custo_range[1], custo_range[2]),
    preco_produto = runif(n, preco_range[1], preco_range[2]),
    eficacia = eficacia
  ) %>% 
    mutate(
      cd_base = cd_base,
      coeficiente_dano = cd_base * rendimento_potencial,
      LDE = (custo_controle / (preco_produto * coeficiente_dano)) * eficacia
    )
  return(simulacoes)
}


n = 50000 # number of simulations
media_rp = 12.36 # in ton/ha
sd_rp = 0.70  # SD of attainable yield
eficacia = rnorm(50000, 0.54, 0.1) #  in proportion
cd_base = 0.05
custo_range = c(40, 160) # cust of control (US$)
preco_range = c(100, 600) # soybean price (US$)

# run the simulation
simula_g3 <- simula_LDE(n, media_rp, sd_rp, eficacia, cd_base, custo_range, preco_range)
```

# Elasticidade

```{r}

# Parâmetros do modelo (exemplo)
beta0 <- 11142.94
beta1 <- -292

# Função de elasticidade
elasticidade <- function(S, b0, b1) {
  yield <- b0 + b1 * S
  E <- b1 * (S / yield)
  return(E)
}

# Severidade de 1% a 80%
S <- seq(0, 9, by = 0.01)
E <- sapply(S, elasticidade, b0 = beta0, b1 = beta1)

# Plot
plot(S, E, type="l", lwd=2, col="blue",
     xlab="Severidade (%)",
     ylab="Elasticidade da perda",
     main="Elasticidade da perda ao longo da severidade")
abline(h=0, lty=2)


```

```{r}

# Parâmetros de exemplo
mod <- list(
  GROUP1   = c(beta0=11142.94, beta1=-292),
  GROUP2  = c(beta0=9692.06, beta1=-206.01),
  GROUP3  = c(beta0=12368.25, beta1=-682.34)
)

S <- seq(1, 8, 1)

plot(NULL, xlim=c(1,8), ylim=c(-1,0),
     xlab="Severidade (%)", ylab="Elasticidade",
     main="Comparação da elasticidade entre cultivares")

cols <- c("darkgreen", "orange", "red")

i <- 1
for(cult in names(mod)) {
  beta0 <- mod[[cult]][1]
  beta1 <- mod[[cult]][2]
  E <- sapply(S, elasticidade, b0=beta0, b1=beta1)
  
  lines(S, E, col=cols[i], lwd=2)
  
  i <- i + 1
}

legend("bottomleft", legend=names(mod), col=cols, lwd=2)

```

```{r}
     main="Distribuição da elasticidade (Monte Carlo)",

E_sim = as.data.frame(E_sim)
```

```{r}

# ---- Funções ----
elasticidade <- function(S, b0, b1) {
  y <- b0 + b1 * S
  b1 * (S / y)
}

# Títulos bonitos para legendas
nice_names <- c(Baixa="Baixa tolerância", Media="Média tolerância", Alta="Alta tolerância")

# ---- Parâmetros dos seus modelos ----
cultivares <- list(
  Baixa = list(beta0=11204.31, se_b0=222.53, beta1=-365.78, se_b1=49.03, sigma=1448),
  Media = list(beta0= 9370.03, se_b0=186.31, beta1=-342.67, se_b1=62.86, sigma=1268),
  Alta  = list(beta0=13773.58, se_b0=141.61, beta1=-357.02, se_b1=72.38, sigma=1252)
)

# Severidade de referência (ajuste se desejar)
S_ref <- 9  # (%)

```

```{r}
cols <- c(Baixa="#D55E00", Media="#0072B2", Alta="#009E73")

     ylab="Elasticidade da perda", main="Elasticidade × Severidade (3 cultivares)")
abline(h=0, lty=2, col="gray70")

for (nm in names(cultivares)) {
  m <- cultivares[[nm]]
  E <- sapply(S_grid, elasticidade, b0=m$beta0, b1=m$beta1)
  lines(S_grid, E, lwd=2.5, col=cols[[nm]])
}
```

```{r}
  b0 <- rnorm(n_sim, mean=m$beta0, sd=m$se_b0)
  b1 <- rnorm(n_sim, mean=m$beta1, sd=m$se_b1)
  mapply(elasticidade, S=S_ref, b0=b0, b1=b1)
})
```
